scenario_a.notes: Dropdown availability filtering works, but text search for 'Unity' fails to filter student cards. Profile details display in modal pop-ups.

scenario_b.notes: Key skills are explicitly scoped on individual candidate modal cards.

scenario_c.notes: Projects are embedded in profile modals without direct URL routing.

scenario_d.notes: Text search query input does not filter profiles; dropdown filters operate as expected.

scenario_e.notes: Profiles are modal-based; direct URLs cannot be copied or reloaded in incognito windows.

scenario_f.notes: Unpublished profiles are hidden from the public directory view.

scenario_g.notes: UI and modal pop-ups adjust correctly on 390px mobile viewports.

scenario_h.notes: Directory controls and modal close buttons are accessible via keyboard navigation.

scenario_i.notes: Exploratory testing identified missing search query handling and lack of deep linking.

top_findings.title: Text search input fails to filter student profiles
top_findings.description: Typing keywords such as 'unity' into the directory search bar does not filter candidate cards.

top_findings.title: Missing direct URLs for candidate profiles and projects
top_findings.description: Profiles open inside modal dialogs without updating the browser URL, preventing deep-linking and sharing.

top_findings.title: Inability to retain candidate context for employer inquiries
top_findings.description: Due to modal implementation, external sharing or direct linking to an employer inquiry form is unaddressed.

observed_pass: Dropdown availability filtering functions as intended, isolating candidates based on selected availability criteria.
